data: In the IMDB histogram, is the tallest bar in the 0.85–0.9 accuracy range taller than any bar in the 0.5–0.6 range?

The tallest bar in the 0.85–0.9 accuracy range for the IMDB dataset appears to be significantly taller than any bar in the 0.5–0.6 range. This can be observed by comparing the height of the tallest bar in the 0.85–0.9 range with the bars in the 0.5–0.6 range. The tallest bar in the 0.85–0.9 range is clearly higher than any bar in the 0.5–0.6 range. Therefore, the answer is yes.
